Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 152. Category: technique. “Other” Ki Techniques.

Rank 2 technique
Ki Cost: 10x ki
Casting Time: 1 bonus action
Prerequisites: None
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (10x Feet)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Other
All creatures in a 10 foot radius must make a
successful strength saving throw or be knocked back 20
feet, 10 on a feet on a success. For every 10 ki you
spend you add 10 feet to the range.
